obligations.statement: The product must provide an enclosed volume for storage.
The product must include a reusable latch that can be engaged and released multiple times.
The product must have a traversable path between open and closed configurations, in both directions.
The closed configuration must not be left without a deliberate action by the user.
The effort a user applies to release the retaining function must be easy.
The retaining function must remain engaged after a transport disturbance.
The product must be suitable for low-cost manufacturing.
The product must be practical for desktop use in terms of space occupied.
All declared relationships must have a physical realization.
There must be an ordered installation sequence with a clear path for every part.

load_cases.scenario_name: opening and closing on a desk

candidates.name: Box with Compliant Flexure Hinge and Friction Latch

acceptance_contracts.statement: The release effort shall be measured and compared to an ergonomic threshold.
acceptance_contracts.test_setup: A force gauge applies a pull/push to the latch release until it disengages, measuring peak force.
acceptance_contracts.pass_criterion: Peak force less than or equal to a specified ergonomic limit.

acceptance_contracts.statement: The latch shall remain engaged when subjected to a defined transport disturbance.
acceptance_contracts.test_setup: The closed product is subjected to a specified vibration or shock profile while latched.
acceptance_contracts.pass_criterion: The latch does not disengage during the disturbance.

acceptance_contracts.statement: The manufacturing cost per unit shall be below a specified target.
acceptance_contracts.test_setup: A cost estimation is performed based on the chosen materials and processes.
acceptance_contracts.pass_criterion: Estimated cost less than or equal to the target.

acceptance_contracts.statement: The footprint of the product shall fit within a defined desktop envelope.
acceptance_contracts.test_setup: The maximum length, width, and height are measured and compared to the envelope.
acceptance_contracts.pass_criterion: All dimensions within the specified limits.

assumptions: No dimension, position, material, or process is specified; any such parameters remain undefined.
The product is a single enclosed volume that can be opened and closed.
The latch is the retaining function that keeps the box closed.
The user is the only actor requiring access.
Load magnitudes for gravity, handling, and transport are not provided; they are to be treated as unknowns.
Assembly is manual and occurs in a factory or by the user; no specific tools are required.
